content: How should I calculate the "Revenue Loss Rate" (RLR)? What columns and formula should I use? Also, for the priority classification: does "Having critical alerts" mean any alert with alertstat='Critical' for that plant?

args.question: How should I calculate the "Revenue Loss Rate" (RLR)? What columns and formula should I use? Also, for the priority classification: does "Having critical alerts" mean any alert with alertstat='Critical' for that plant?

result: To calculate the Revenue Loss Rate (RLR), you should use the `total_revenue_loss` and `gencapmw` columns. The formula is `total_revenue_loss / gencapmw`. If `gencapmw` is zero or null, the RLR should be null. Regarding critical alerts, yes, "Having critical alerts" means any alert with `alertstat` equal to 'Critical' for that plant.

SELECT m.powerref, 
       SUM(m.maintcostusd) as total_maint_cost,
       SUM(m.cleancostusd) as total_clean_cost,
       SUM(m.replacecostusd) as total_replace_cost,
       SUM(m.revlossusd) as total_rev_loss
FROM maintenance m
GROUP BY m.powerref
LIMIT 5;

WITH plant_maintenance AS (
    SELECT 
        p.growregistry,
        p.growalias as plant_name,
        p.gencapmw as capacity_mw,
        SUM(m.maintcostusd) + SUM(m.cleancostusd) + SUM(m.replacecostusd) as total_maintenance_costs,
        SUM(m.revlossusd) as revenue_losses
    FROM plant p
    JOIN maintenance m ON p.growregistry = m.powerref
    GROUP BY p.growregistry, p.growalias, p.gencapmw
),
plant_alerts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.compreg as growregistry,
        MAX(CASE WHEN a.alertstat = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_critical_alerts
    FROM alerts a
    GROUP BY a.compreg
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.plant_name,
        pm.capacity_mw,
        pm.total_maintenance_costs,
        pm.revenue_losses,
        CASE WHEN pm.capacity_mw > 0 THEN pm.total_maintenance_costs / pm.capacity_mw ELSE NULL END as mce_score,
        CASE WHEN pm.capacity_mw > 0 THEN pm.revenue_losses / pm.capacity_mw ELSE NULL END as rlr,
        pa.has_critical_alerts
    FROM plant_maintenance pm
    LEFT JOIN plant_alerts pa ON pm.growregistry = pa.growregistry
)
SELECT 
    plant_name,
    capacity_mw,
    total_maintenance_costs,
    revenue_losses,
    ROUND(CAST(mce_score AS numeric), 2) as maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
    ROUND(CAST(rlr AS numeric), 2) as revenue_loss_rate,
    CASE 
        WHEN mce_score IS NOT NULL AND rlr IS NOT NULL AND mce_score != 0 
        THEN ROUND(CAST((rlr / mce_score) AS numeric), 2) 
        ELSE NULL 
    END as mroi_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN has_critical_alerts = 1 AND (rlr / mce_score) > 2.0 THEN 'URGENT'
        WHEN has_critical_alerts = 1 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN (rlr / mce_score) > 2.0 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END as priority_level
FROM combined
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN has_critical_alerts = 1 AND (rlr / mce_score) > 2.0 THEN 1
        WHEN has_critical_alerts = 1 THEN 2
        WHEN (rlr / mce_score) > 2.0 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END,
    mroi_value DESC;
